verifiable-quality-gates.why: the data-loss fix is pinned by tests that FAIL when reverted: a local file in an UNchanged mirrored skill survives a reconcile (re-mirror only changed), a local file in a re-mirrored skill is backed up not deleted, and --check --skills reports a drifted TARGET copy (#130)
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added six ISSUE-130 discrimination cases (incl. the pre-signature-marker backup, --check/--yes self-healing, and unreadable-target stop a fresh-context review required); 50/50 esk-init tests; full suite 732 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: changing the mirror's delete-and-replace semantics to back-up-on-divergence and re-mirror-only-changed, and making --check fingerprint the target, is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0078 covering the three changes and the honest limits (whole-folder backup not per-file merge; per-skill divergence granularity; unreadable target stops rather than replaces)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: each fix is pinned at the level that owns it: an integration test that runs the real esk-init against a fixture source repo + a temp --skills-target and asserts the real on-disk result (file survived, backup present, exit code)
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-based reconcile tests for the only-changed, backup-on-divergence, and target-drift paths
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed: a local addition in an unchanged skill, a local addition in a re-mirrored skill, and a target copy swapped for a different one
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: node:test cases, each asserting the real filesystem state or --check exit code after a reconcile
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: ADR-0078 states the honest limits rather than overclaiming: the backup is a whole-folder copy not a per-file merge, divergence is per-skill not per-file, and an unreadable target is reported-and-stopped, not backed up
skeptical-audit.what: recorded each limit in ADR-0078 and verified the suite green before claiming the fix
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the mirror-safety delta before the PR, checking the signature refactor, the backup-before-replace boundary, and the --check target comparison
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no user input/auth/session/secret/upload surface; file handling is local installer mirroring and the remove path keeps its existing plain-child guard; the backup/replace adds no traversal surface

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the fix reuses the existing fingerprint + mirror structure

arch-encode.why: the fix is enforced by discrimination tests, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration or audit logic; this preserves a developer's local files under ~/.claude during an installer reconcile, not regulated-data lifecycle

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism; esk-init is a local installer, not a release path

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; developer-facing installer tooling

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or frontend code; developer-facing installer tooling

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; developer-facing installer tooling
